referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ground heat exchanger for an office building with a specific air flow rate of 0.92 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. The reference value of the inventory is 1 m2 heated gross floor area. The inventory is based on a study of an appartment building with 6 flats, a heated gross floor area of The inventory is based on a long ground heat exchanger with a specific duct lenght of 0.167m per m3 nominal air flow. m3/h. The inventory includes a ground heat exchanger with 200mm diameter and a lenght of 0.667m/m2. The data represents a ground heat exchanger made of polyethylene. It includes the excavating needed and a bedding layer made of poor concrete.; UUID: 2b5b7342-6d00-329e-9798-723f3e053bd2
